sources.title: Web Audio API 1.1
sources.relevance: Defines AudioContext output timestamps and the separation between rendering and control timelines used by the existing sampler and evaluator.

sources.title: Web Audio API Editor's Draft
sources.relevance: Current primary working specification for getOutputTimestamp, baseLatency, and outputLatency behavior.

finding: The remaining evidence gap after R-030 was not another clock evaluator but orchestration: raw capture, clock evaluation, route layers, deployment identity, and the final packet could be produced under different identifiers or composed after unavailable or contradicted clock evidence. A single fail-closed session boundary removes that ambiguity.
design_implication: Use one orchestrator that binds sessionId, commitSha, and deploymentId to every layer; preserve raw capture and clock evaluation; refuse packet composition unless clock evidence is observed and consistent; and preserve physical not-heard contradictions rather than converting browser rendering into an audibility claim.

comparison_against_prior_work.R-028: Composes pre-existing evidence layers but does not acquire or evaluate browser clock evidence.
comparison_against_prior_work.R-030: Captures browser clock samples and gates forwarding.
comparison_against_prior_work.R-031: Integrates R-028 through R-030 into one identity-bound session and fails closed before composition.

verified_behaviors: one shared identity across capture, evaluation, and composed packet

uncertainty: No immutable deployment session was executed.
No browser microphone or physical speaker evidence was collected.
The test context is deterministic and does not reproduce browser scheduling jitter.
Safari implementation support remains an empirical question.
falsification_route: Run the orchestrator inside an immutable exact-commit browser session.
Verify every emitted layer carries the same sessionId, commitSha, and deploymentId.
Inject unavailable and regressing output timestamps and confirm no packet is composed.
Record a render-advancing but not-heard physical outcome and confirm the final packet remains contradicted.
Reject the design if any absent, contradicted, or mismatched layer is promoted to supported evidence.
claim_boundary: This artifact coordinates browser evidence provenance. It does not prove acoustic output, physical audibility, conscious perception, diagnosis, or treatment.
